_meta.datasheet_section: Ordering Information p2; Figure 3 TCXO pin-out (top view) + Table 13 p10; Table 2 DC; Table 8 abs max; p37 Dimensions and Land Pattern
_meta.notes: Decode: A rev, E -40..105 °C, C clipped sinewave, F 5.0x3.2, Q ±0.1 ppm, 33 = 3.3 V ±10%, N = pin 1 No Connect (TCXO mode), T = 3k reel. TCXO mode: no I2C, so pins 2/5/10 are NC. NC pins may float; layout guide recommends grounding them. IDD 44 typ / 53 max mA.

pins.name: NC
pins.note: 'N' option: no connect, H/L/open no effect

pins.name: CLK
pins.note: clipped sinewave 0.8-1.2 V into 10 kΩ||10 pF; AC-couple

pins.name: VDD
pins.note: 44 mA typ / 53 mA max; 0.1 µF within 1-2 mm + 10 µF required; abs max 4 V
